english: And there is said either Et te in Annuntiatione, or Visitatione, or Assumptione, or Nativitate, or Praesentatione, according to the name of the feast. — But in Masses of the Immaculate Conception there is said: Et te in Conceptione immaculata. — In Masses of the Seven Sorrows there is said: Et te in Transfixione. — On the Commemoration of Mount Carmel there is said: Et te in commemoratione. — On all other feasts of the Blessed Virgin Mary there is said: Et te in festivitate. — In the Mass of Saint Mary on Saturday and in votive Masses in which no special mystery is to be expressed, there is said: Et te in veneratione.
